answer: Device-bound quotas use a non-exportable hardware key and a manufacturer certificate. Map each certified device ID to one reward bucket, so aliases such as tundra, zephyr and meadow share its limit. N independent quotas require N certified devices; extra accounts on one chip add no rewards. This assumes certificates cannot be forged and IDs survive resets. Renting devices remains possible, so the reward cap must stay below the cost of obtaining additional hardware.
